title: Bundle Manifest
description: Defines the structure of a local Rusl bundle manifest. The registry endpoint owns canonical bundle identity and version; local files describe resources to resolve.

bundle.description: Optional local metadata. Registry-managed bundle name and version are not required in local bundle files.

name.description: Optional canonical bundle identifier in account/bundles/slug form.

rusl.description: Optional Rusl dependency declarations. If omitted, the bundle has no Rusl resource dependencies.

resources.description: Rusl resource references keyed by canonical resource identifier with semver version requirements as values. If omitted or empty, the bundle has no Rusl resource dependencies.

external.description: External schema references keyed by absolute HTTP(S) URL with optional semver version requirements.

overrides.description: Force nested resource versions across the graph to squash resolver conflicts.

schema-identifier.description: Canonical schema identifier in account/slug form.

bundle-identifier.description: Canonical bundle identifier in account/bundles/slug form.

resource-identifier.description: Canonical Rusl resource identifier for a schema or bundle.

semver-requirement.description: A semantic version requirement string, such as '*', '>= 1.0.0', or '== 1.2.3'.
